acceptance_criteria.description: The three package contract tests pass on the current Windows Codex runtime.

closed_decisions: Match the quoted pnpm script target after %~dp0 without assuming an extra separator, allow pnpm.cjs and pnpm.mjs, resolve its dot-segment path relative to the shim directory, and execute it with process.execPath.
Keep shell false and preserve the existing direct JavaScript CLI path and executable-command fallbacks.
forbidden_changes: Do not edit production code or any other file, enable shell execution, commit, push, open a PR, or touch Jira.
objective: Make the package-test pnpm resolver recognize Windows command shims whose quoted target is a package-relative pnpm.cjs or pnpm.mjs path, while retaining shell-free execution.
